context_requirements: SLC6A4 and/or SLC6A2 expression (monoaminergic reuptake machinery)
Intact serotonergic/noradrenergic signalling for downstream transcriptional effects
Concentrations sufficient for off-target effects (e.g. STAT3 inhibition) rather than reuptake blockade
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Concentration-dependent transcriptional signature shared across lines that is abolished by SLC6A4/SLC6A2 knockdown
Induction of a clear STAT3-dependent or apoptosis-related transcriptional program at 10 µM

evidence.supports: Duloxetine binds pSTAT3 and reduces IL-6-induced STAT3/pSTAT3 in C2C12 cells, but this is an off-target, non-transcriptional reuptake-independent effect and the paper is retracted
Duloxetine combined with paclitaxel affects CDK1/apoptosis in ovarian cancer cells, again an off-target effect requiring co-treatment, not a direct SNRI transcriptional program
